name: flynas Company
via: Listed on Tadawul since June 2025; shareholders in its IPO prospectus
note: flynas listed a 30% stake on Tadawul in June 2025. Substantial shareholders post-offering (prospectus tables 0.2/0.3): National Flight Services Company 28.88% (wholly owned by Prince Khalid bin Sultan bin Abdulaziz Al Saud), Kingdom Holding Company 27.44% (78.14% Prince Alwaleed bin Talal, 16.87% PIF), and Nasser Ibrahim Rashid Al Rashid 6.53%. PIF's indirect stake in flynas is 4.63% post-offering, below a 5% test.
